title: What Fishmongering Is All About
description: Fishmongers buy, break down, and sell fresh seafood at markets and counters. They judge freshness, fillet whole fish, advise customers on selection and cooking, and manage the cold chain. Fish markets, grocery seafood counters, sushi suppliers, and wholesale distributors. Coastal cities and foodie markets are the core settings. This record lays the foundation: the core purpose, the people it serves, and where it fits in everyday life.

title: Myths vs Facts

When in doubt, trust measured results and experienced practitioners over slogans.
